subject: Export dashboard
body: How do I export my dashboard to PDF? I only see the CSV export option.

subject: Invoice wrong after plan change
body: After switching from the Pro plan to the Team plan last week we were billed for both plans this month. Can you fix the invoice?

gold.review_note: A plan change that produces wrong charges is billing, not account.

subject: Delete my data
body: Please delete all personal data you hold about me under GDPR Article 17. You can reach me on +1 415 555 0134 if you need to verify my identity.

gold.review_note: GDPR erasure requests carry a statutory deadline, so at least P2.

subject: Lots of problems since the 5.2 mobile update
body: I want to report several problems with the mobile app since the 5.2 update. First, the app crashes every time I open the Reports tab on Android 15 (Pixel 8). Second, push notifications arrive 20-40 minutes late. Third, in dark mode the table headers are black text on a dark grey background and unreadable. Fourth, when I edit entries offline and reconnect, every edited entry is duplicated. Fifth, battery drain went from about 4% to 15% per hour with the app in the background. Finally, I am logged out every morning even though 'remember me' is ticked. We have 12 field staff relying on this app daily, so please look at all of these.

subject: API rate limit errors
body: Our integration gets HTTP 429 responses from your API even though we stay under the documented limit of 100 requests per minute. Orders are queuing up on our side.

subject: Payment keeps failing
body: My renewal payment failed three times with 'card_declined_do_not_honor' but my bank says there is no block on the card. I need to renew before Friday or we lose access.

subject: Question
body: Is there a discount for nonprofits? Also the app felt a bit slow yesterday.
